[EN] Dougal has a special training mission for the Idoneal Force.

Prove your power by defeating 10 Brutal Onyx Hydraths, 10 Brutal Iron Giants, and 10 Brutal Naga Battlemasters on the Island of Dawn.

- Use the Vanguard Requests window to teleport to the Island of Dawn.
- Warriors, lancers, berserkers, slayers, priests, mystics, and brawlers can receive Apex quests upon reaching item level 439.
- Enchanting weapons can greatly increase your item level.
- The document "Apex Mission 439" vanishes when you accept this quest.
[ES] Dougal tiene una misión de entrenamiento especial para la Idoneal Force.

Prueba tu poder derrotando a 10 Brutal Onyx Hydraths, 10 Brutal Iron Giants y 10 Brutal Naga Battlemasters en Island of Dawn.

- Usa la ventana de Vanguard Requests para teletransportarte a Island of Dawn.
- Warriors, lancers, berserkers, slayers, priests, mystics y brawlers pueden recibir misiones de Apex al alcanzar el nivel de objeto 439.
- Encantar armas puede incrementar enormemente tu nivel de objeto.
- El documento "Apex Mission 439" desaparecerá al aceptar esta misión.

[EN] Great job, .

Your achievements have exceeded my expectations!

Claim your final reward, and continue your journey.
[ES] ¡Buen trabajo, .

Tus logros han superado mis expectativas!

Reclama tu recompensa final y continúa tu viaje.
